items.source: Check if data is available and either call onDataAvailable() immediately or schedule a notification.
items.translation: 检查数据是否可用，并立即调用onDataAvailable()或安排通知。

items.source: Invoked when reading is possible, either in the same thread after a check via checkOnDataAvailable(), or as a callback from the underlying container.
items.translation: 在通过checkOnDataAvailable()检查后同一线程中，或作为底层容器的回调时，如果可以进行读取，则调用此方法。

items.source: Note: This method is guaranteed not to compete with checkOnDataAvailable() so it can be used to safely suspend reading, if the underlying API supports it, i.e. without competing with an implicit call to resume via checkOnDataAvailable().
items.translation: 注意： 此方法保证不会与checkOnDataAvailable()竞争，因此如果底层 API 支持，可以安全地挂起读取，即不与通过 checkOnDataAvailable() 进行的隐式恢复调用竞争。

items.source:
Specifically a base class for reading from the HTTP request body with
Servlet non-blocking I/O as well as handling incoming
WebSocket messages with standard Jakarta WebSocket (JSR-356), and Jetty.
items.translation: 具体来说，这是一个用于从 HTTP 请求体中读取数据的基础类，支持 Servlet 的非阻塞 I/O，并能够处理传入的 WebSocket 消息，兼容标准的 Jakarta WebSocket（JSR-356）以及 Jetty。

items.source: Special logger for debugging Reactive Streams signals.
items.translation: 用于调试 Reactive Streams 信号的专用日志记录器。

items.source: Create an instance with the given log prefix.
items.translation: 使用给定的日志前缀创建实例。

items.source:
Invoked after an I/O read error from the underlying server or after a
cancellation signal from the downstream consumer to allow subclasses
to discard any current cached data they might have.
items.translation: 在底层服务器发生 I/O 读取错误或下游消费者发出取消信号后调用，以便子类可以丢弃可能存在的任何当前缓存数据。

items.source: Return the configured log message prefix.
items.translation: 返回配置的日志消息前缀。

items.source:
Subclasses can call this method to signal onComplete, delegating a
notification from the container when all data has been read.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来发出 onComplete 信号，委托容器在读取完所有数据时进行通知。

items.source:
Subclasses can call this to signal onError, delegating a
notification from the container for an error.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来触发 onError，从而委托容器对错误的通知。

items.source: Read once from the input, if possible.
items.translation: 如果可能，请从输入中读取一次。

items.source: subscribe in interface Publisher<T>
items.translation: `subscribe` 方法在接口 `Publisher<T>` 中。

items.source: T - the type of element signaled
items.translation: T - 被通知元素的类型

items.source: the item that was read; or null
Arjen Poutsma, Violeta Georgieva, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma, Violeta Georgieva, Rossen Stoyanchev

items.source: Invoked when reading is paused due to a lack of demand.
items.translation: 在因需求不足而暂停读取时调用。
